description: Fast local-first Markdown knowledge base with live preview, search, graph, Dataview, book reader and MCP server
notes: Extracted from the vendor's NSIS setup, so this is a genuine portable install under the
Scoop apps directory - the setup is never executed, no elevation is required.
Aquilum has a built-in updater. Decline its in-app update prompt and use `scoop update`
instead: accepting it runs the NSIS setup, which installs a second, unmanaged copy into
Settings and caches live in %APPDATA%\com.dmitriy.aquilum-app and
%LOCALAPPDATA%\com.dmitriy.aquilum-app (outside Scoop's control): they survive updates and
`scoop uninstall` leaves them behind. Your notes stay in whatever vault folder you chose.
post_install: # NSIS plumbing from the setup archive - not part of the app.
pre_uninstall: # A running instance holds aquilum-app.exe open; without this both
# `scoop update` and `scoop uninstall` fail with a file-in-use error.
